Article 3: Definitions
                                  What is an AI system?
‘AI system’ means a machine-based system that is designed
to operate with varying levels of autonomy and that may be
adaptive after deployment.

...that, for explicit or implicit purposes, infers from the
input it receives how to produce results, such as
predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions that
may affect the physical or virtual environment;

Literacy in the DIGI/AI context
                                                            Literacy is directly linked to skills, and it is more about
                                                            competence. In addition to this, competence is the ability to
                                                            perform a task effectively and successfully.

                                                            Broadly speaking, literacy is more about knowing, and
                                                            competence is more about applying knowledge effectively
                                                            and usefully. It is about confidence and attitude, and focuses
                                                            on how well the AI user is doing.
